name: Atlassian Corporation
blurb: Atlassian Corporation is a leading provider of team collaboration and productivity software, known for products like Jira, Confluence, and Trello. The company serves a wide range of customers from small teams to large enterprises, with a strong focus on cloud-based solutions. As of 2026, Atlassian holds a significant market position in the DevOps and agile project management space, competing with Microsoft and other SaaS providers.
recent: In the past 30 days, Atlassian reported strong fiscal Q3 2026 earnings on April 30, highlighting robust cloud and data center growth, which sent the stock soaring 29% on May 1. The stock had been the worst performer in the Nasdaq-100 earlier in the year but staged a dramatic reversal following the earnings beat. As of May 6, 2026, TEAM traded at $88.80, still well below its 52-week high of $232.36.
